advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Verify that repointing the global REBAR_ROOT (used by repo_root/resolve_run_root/reconciler_repo_root, not just the attested object DB) at an empty mcp-code dir does not regress non-attested read/write/reconciler paths during the pre-convergence window.
evidence: src/rebar/_config_resolvers.py:394 `env_root = os.environ.get("REBAR_ROOT")` in resolve_run_root (scratch base)
src/rebar/config.py:530 `reconciler_repo_root` reads REBAR_ROOT
src/rebar/_config_resolvers.py:250 repo_root reads REBAR_ROOT with precedence env>git
infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh:190 comment: 'runs in the BACKGROUND ... allowed to outlive the 120s ... readiness deadline' — REBAR_ROOT is set before the checkout exists
advisory.finding: REBAR_ROOT is the single global repo-root override consumed by many rebar code paths (repo_root, resolve_run_root's workflow scratch base, reconciler_repo_root), not only the attested gates' object-DB lookup. Repointing it at /var/gerrit/site/mcp-code changes root resolution for the whole MCP server process; until the backgrounded clone converges (and permanently in the no-PAT / absent-mount skip cases) this directory is empty, so any non-attested read/write path that resolves repo_root against it now sees an empty non-git dir rather than the prior /app.
scenarios: The convergence window after every (re)deploy before the blobless clone finishes
Any MCP operation that resolves repo_root / run scratch base rather than only the attested object DB

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Ensure the code checkout is provisioned (or REBAR_ROOT/attestation is handled) even when MCP_TICKETS_PAT is blank, since compose documents blank-PAT as a supported boot state.
evidence: mcp-entrypoint.sh:266 `if [ -n "${MCP_TICKETS_PAT:-}" ]; then`
mcp-entrypoint.sh:293 `provision_code || rc=1` (nested inside that block)

docker-compose.yml:386-388 `# Materialized from SSM into the .env by fetch-secrets.sh; BLANK IS FINE — the clone is simply deferred and the container still boots ... MCP_TICKETS_PAT: "${MCP_TICKETS_PAT:-}"`
REBAR_ROOT: "/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code" is set unconditionally (docker-compose.yml:376, Dockerfile.mcp:91) regardless of whether the code checkout was provisioned
advisory.finding: The code checkout (provision_code) is only invoked inside the `if [ -n "${MCP_TICKETS_PAT:-}" ]` guard, so when MCP_TICKETS_PAT is blank — a state docker-compose.yml explicitly documents as supported ('BLANK IS FINE — the container still boots') — the /var/gerrit/site/mcp-code checkout is never cloned even though REBAR_ROOT still points there. The stated defect (attested gates lacking an object DB to resolve origin/main) remains unfixed in that deploy path, and the failure surface merely shifts to an empty repo root.
scenarios: A production deploy where the SSM PAT slot is blank (or fetch-secrets left it empty): tickets store defers AND the code checkout is silently never attempted, so REBAR_ROOT points at an empty volume and every source=attested gate still fails.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a provisioning test with pat=None asserting the intended code-checkout / REBAR_ROOT behavior when MCP_TICKETS_PAT is blank.
evidence: test helper default `pat: str | None = "stub-pat"` (test file:137)
new test calls `_provision(tmp_path, head_resolves=True, env={"MCP_CODE_DIR": str(code)})` with no pat override, so pat='stub-pat'
provision_code is gated on MCP_TICKETS_PAT (mcp-entrypoint.sh:266,293), which the test never exercises as blank
advisory.finding: The blank-PAT provisioning path (pat=None) is not covered by the new test: test_the_code_root_is_provisioned... and the shared _provision helper default to pat='stub-pat', so no test asserts what happens to the code checkout / REBAR_ROOT when MCP_TICKETS_PAT is empty — the exact production state compose calls out as normal.
scenarios: A regression that leaves the code checkout unprovisioned under a blank PAT would pass CI because no test drives pat=None through the code-checkout assertions.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Reduce the MCP_CODE_DIR/REBAR_ROOT declarations to a single source of truth (or extend the parity check to include the Dockerfile ENV) to prevent drift.
evidence: Dockerfile.mcp:89-91 `ENV REBAR_TRACKER_DIR=... MCP_CODE_DIR=/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code REBAR_ROOT=/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code`
docker-compose.yml:375-376 `MCP_CODE_DIR: "/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code"` / `REBAR_ROOT: "/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code"`
autodeploy.sh:387-388 `-e "MCP_CODE_DIR=/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code"` / `-e "REBAR_ROOT=/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code"`
docker-compose.yml:374 comment `MUST stay at parity with mcp_run_new in infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` names only autodeploy, not the Dockerfile ENV
advisory.finding: MCP_CODE_DIR and REBAR_ROOT are declared in three independent locations — Dockerfile.mcp ENV, docker-compose.yml service env, and autodeploy.sh mcp_run_new — but the documented compose-parity guard only pins compose against autodeploy, leaving the Dockerfile ENV copy free to drift out of sync.
scenarios: Someone changes the mount path in the Dockerfile ENV but not in compose/autodeploy (or vice versa); the parity test (compose<->autodeploy) would not catch a Dockerfile-vs-runtime divergence.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that fails the CODE clone (head_resolves=True, clone_fails=True, MCP_CODE_DIR under tmp_path) and asserts the run still completes, emits 'clone deferred', and surfaces a non-zero exit status.
evidence: mcp-entrypoint.sh:242-246: `git clone --filter=blob:none --single-branch --branch main "${MCP_TICKETS_URL}" "$code_dir" || { echo "mcp: code checkout clone deferred (deploy canary)" >&2; code_rc=1; }`
mcp-entrypoint.sh:293: `provision_code || rc=1`
Diff commit message: 'a failure is REPORTED and stepped over, never swallowed into a success and never allowed to stop the container booting.'

Named violating input: `_provision(tmp_path, head_resolves=True, clone_fails=True, env={"MCP_CODE_DIR": str(code)})` — tickets healthy so the ONLY clone is the code clone; asserts nothing about the code-clone-deferred branch or that its rc surfaces while ran_to_completion stays true.
ABSENCE: no test in the diff sets clone_fails with head_resolves=True to isolate a code-side clone failure.
advisory.finding: The soft-failure posture for the CODE clone is newly added but untested: no test injects a code-clone failure to verify `provision_code || rc=1` surfaces in the exit status while still letting the container boot (ensure step and terminal line still run). The existing `test_a_failing_clone_surfaces_and_is_not_reported_as_success` uses `head_resolves=False`, so its `clone_fails=True` exercises the tickets reclone, not the code clone.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test pointing MCP_CODE_DIR at a leaf whose parent is absent and assert the code checkout is announced-and-skipped (stderr 'mount point ... is absent') without changing the exit status.
evidence: mcp-entrypoint.sh:215-219: `code_parent="$(dirname "$code_dir")"; if [ ! -d "$code_parent" ]; then echo "mcp: code checkout skipped — its mount point ${code_parent} is absent" >&2; return 0; fi`
Comment states this is NOT a provisioning failure: 'that is NOT a provisioning failure, so it is announced and SKIPPED rather than reported as one.'

Named violating input: `_provision(tmp_path, head_resolves=True, env={"MCP_CODE_DIR": "/nonexistent-parent/mcp-code"})` (or leaving MCP_CODE_DIR at the default whose parent /var/gerrit/site is absent in the sandbox) — must emit 'mount point ... is absent' and keep rc==0.
ABSENCE: the only new test passes MCP_CODE_DIR=tmp_path/'code' whose parent (tmp_path) always exists, so the skip branch never executes.
advisory.finding: The newly added mount-point-absent SKIP branch of clone_code (announce-and-skip returning 0, explicitly NOT a provisioning failure) is untested. No test drives an MCP_CODE_DIR whose parent directory does not exist to confirm the container still boots cleanly (rc unaffected) rather than reporting a failure.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test seeding a resolvable MCP_CODE_DIR/.git and assert no branch-main code clone is issued (idempotent skip), analogous to the healthy-tickets-store test.
evidence: mcp-entrypoint.sh:255-258: `provision_code() { if code_repo_present; then return 0; fi ... }`
mcp-entrypoint.sh:195-201: code_repo_present requires both `${MCP_CODE_DIR}/.git` present AND `git -C ... rev-parse --verify -q HEAD`.

Named violating input: `_provision(tmp_path, head_resolves=True, env={"MCP_CODE_DIR": str(code)})` with `code/.git` pre-seeded and head-resolving — a regression that always re-cloned the code side would blow the readiness budget yet no assertion catches it.
ABSENCE: no test seeds a pre-existing healthy MCP_CODE_DIR to assert the skip.
advisory.finding: The idempotent-skip path for a healthy CODE checkout (provision_code's code_repo_present short-circuit) is newly added but untested: no test seeds a resolvable code checkout and asserts no redundant code clone fires, mirroring the tickets-store `test_healthy_store_is_neither_cleared_nor_recloned`.

blocking.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm intended behaviour when MCP_TICKETS_PAT is unset: REBAR_ROOT now points at an unpopulated mcp-code dir because provision_code is skipped, unlike the prior unset->/app resolution.
evidence: infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh:266 `if [ -n "${MCP_TICKETS_PAT:-}" ]; then`
infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh:293 `provision_code || rc=1` (inside the PAT-gated block)
infra/compose/Dockerfile.mcp:91 `REBAR_ROOT=/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code` (set unconditionally)
ABSENCE: no branch sets/leaves REBAR_ROOT when provision_code is skipped, so the env var and the on-disk state diverge when the PAT is absent
blocking.finding: provision_code (and thus the code checkout REBAR_ROOT points at) is only reachable when MCP_TICKETS_PAT is set, but REBAR_ROOT is exported unconditionally to /var/gerrit/site/mcp-code in Dockerfile.mcp, docker-compose.yml, and autodeploy.sh. When no PAT is present the checkout is never created, so REBAR_ROOT resolves to an empty/nonexistent directory rather than the pre-change /app source copy — a different (and possibly worse) failure surface for any code path that resolves the repo root.
scenarios: MCP container booted with no MCP_TICKETS_PAT (e.g. a bare `docker run` of the image, or SSM PAT not yet wired)
